title: BeerSmith Batch Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beersmith:batch
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(recipe_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many BeerSmith batch events land each day and how many distinct recipe values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest BeerSmith batch records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct recipe values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It catches how much BeerSmith batch activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
